## 2. Professional Summary
Dibendu Gorai is a React Native Developer with 3.5+ years of extensive experience building scalable, high-performance mobile and web applications for Android, iOS, and Web. He specializes in React Native, React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript, supplemented by experience in Kotlin and SwiftUI. He has architected resilient offline-first mobile workflows using Realm Database, managed production releases across Google Play Store and Apple App Store using Fastlane, implemented scalable state machines using Redux Toolkit, and built enterprise CRM web applications.
